license.redistribution_review: required: NVIDIA cuBLAS/cuDNN/NVRTC redistribution terms and complete native dependency closure

transformations: Isolated PyInstaller CUDA 12 executable built from exact worker uv.lock; bundles redistributable NVIDIA cuBLAS, cuDNN and NVRTC; no weights

minimum_resources.note: Measured on RTX 4060 Ti: NVIDIA libraries about 2 GiB unpacked; exact packaged bytes determined by target-native build

blocked_reason: Target-native CUDA runtime archive, public release URL, NVIDIA redistribution review, complete native/codec notices and detached project signature must be supplied by the release owner; no placeholder URL or hash is shipped.

unsupported_platforms.macos-aarch64: CUDA is not available on macOS
unsupported_platforms.macos-x86_64: CUDA is not available on macOS

gpu.note: CUDA 12 / cuDNN 9; driver 525 or newer; about 2 GiB free GPU memory for Whisper small

description: Optional NVIDIA CUDA Whisper worker. Large separate download (cuDNN and cuBLAS); never part of the installer. Selected explicitly per model profile via device=cuda; no silent CPU fallback.
